limitation: Fixed single-node RTX5090 TP8 workload. Old C/A use original Flux rank-offset scheduling and full-remote quantization; no interleave, arrival calibration or selective mask. Unquantized Flux uses GemmOnly plus NCCL BF16 Reduce-Scatter without P2P. GEMM, decoder, transport and rounding differ across arms; gains are end-to-end combinations. No historical pooling or filtering of negative gains; six paired CIs are unadjusted.
